findings.fix: Move identity/input/handoff readiness and job RUNNING before invoking adapter methods; keep verification fail-closed.

findings.finding: Model failure may be recorded as status FAILED with state queued; isolated worker only returns successful records
findings.fix: Persist real failed job state and return correlated error receipt; preserve operation/input identity and actual start/end times.

findings.finding: No generative planner or semantic decision agent in active browser path; planner.py is static option-to-step builder used by legacy CLI
findings.fix: Bind a real instruction/planning provider to validated executable operations; authorized key connection is a separate gate.

findings.finding: Right person text maps to left point because person condition precedes right condition
findings.fix: Resolve explicit spatial instructions before generic nouns; semantic object grounding needs actual model and reference binding.

findings.finding: SAM video tracking is four independent sampled image masks, seeded by previous centroid; output is four overlay frames at2fps; IoU reported but not a passing threshold
findings.fix: Separate sampled-mask demo from production temporal tracking; validate identity continuity/full clip coverage and preservation before claiming full tracking.

findings.finding: UI reference images not forwarded into model job; MediaJob reference_files remains unset in ProductJobService.execute
findings.fix: Bind uploaded reference artifact IDs/hashes to job and pass them to a provider that actually uses them; do not silently ignore them.

findings.finding: Generic model TESTED_PASS validates byte identity/parseability, not subject correctness, tracking accuracy or STT WER without reference
findings.fix: Separate execution success and task quality success; require per-operation task-quality evidence.

findings.finding: Model Scout callback created and accepted in same ProductJobService call; issue_id fixed PR-10; not external agent callback transport
findings.fix: Identify this as local validation receipt; bind real request/project/PR identities and verify actual receiver when claiming cross-agent delivery.
